fact: The Agence de Gestion du Fonds d'Accès Universel (AGEFAU), in partnership with the Ministry of Territorial Administration and Decentralisation, finances a 200 million FCFA project strengthening the digital capacities of 126 communes, and a 715,709,261 FCFA project equipping governorates with solar-powered touchscreens.
title: Administration territoriale: 200 millions de FCFA pour la modernisation numérique des collectivités
